verdict.rationale: Capacities documents first-party Chat Connectors that link ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Le Chat to a space. It also documents an official MCP integration for custom apps, agents and bots, plus a REST API with Bearer auth for programmatic access, which together cover the story's connector path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work, a third-party AI plugin ecosystem, and setup or capability details beyond one-line doc claims.
